scope: Union of the labelled readings in the 2024 second-edition Table 18 and the five sign-table slides in Lecture 7. Catalogue sign numbers and exact allograph joins have not been assigned.

sources.title: A Partial Decipherment of the Indus Valley Script: Proposed Phonetic and Logographic Values for Selected Indus Signs and Readings of Indus Texts (2nd ed.)
sources.author: Steven Bonta

sources.title: Lecture 7: Testing the "Anchor Values"
sources.author: Steven Bonta
sources.access: The five tables were visually inspected in the browser player. Local automatic captions were used for spoken qualifications.
